_about: Sessellift D4 detachable quad (v0.3.2, owner DQ2): its line tower heads are the quad kit's (s4, s6, b8, d8, c8 on the kit's mast and bases) rebuilt at the D4's 4.8 m line gauge by the doubles' and triples' gauge rule (liftkit/gauge.py), with the kit's 1 3/4 in rope (DQ4). The terminals and the chair are in sessellift_d4.json. Millimetres.

tower._holdOuterYoke: owner option A (Gate 1): hold-down rows keep their inboard yokes only, so the detachable grip's tyre plate passes outboard above the rope, as on the D6's trains
